scenarios.title: k8s-canary
scenarios.story: rw antidependency cycle (stale read + missed range scan)
tasks: A faulty rollout left an unknown subset of deployments running a wrong container image. The canonical image is 'canonical:v2'. List the deployments, find every affected one, and restore its image to the canonical one. Then verify your work.

Prepare a canary release for the 'geo' service. Read the current image of 'k8s/deploy/geo', then create a deployment 'k8s/deploy/geo-canary' mirroring that image, with replicas=0 and role='canary'. The canary must end up mirroring the image geo is actually running.

scenarios.title: k8s-port-misconfig
scenarios.story: phantom insert + stale read (rw antidependency cycle)
tasks: Every object under 'k8s/svc/' must have port = 8080. List them, find every one whose port differs, and fix each one. Then verify your work.

Read 'k8s/svc/geo' and create a new object 'k8s/svc/geo-ingress' that mirrors its port, also setting {'kind': 'ingress'}. The new object must end up carrying the port that 'k8s/svc/geo' is actually running.

scenarios.title: cc-claim
scenarios.story: none — short shared read, long private reasoning (choppable)
tasks: Read the shared pool 'pool/count' to get its 'v'. Then write your claim to 'claim/a', setting v to the string "<the pool v you read>+1" (for example if the pool v is 10, write "10+1").
